summary: External authentication services such as LDAP or SAML are called during gRPC authentication and slow responses add latency to every request, so they must be low-latency and reliable; each component's Nginx proxy then routes to WSGI, WebSocket or static content with about 10 ms latency.
questions: Does LDAP slow down every AAP API request?
What does Nginx do in each AAP component?
Why is AAP slow when LDAP is slow?
